snippet.title: Mars Hopper Trailer
snippet.description:
Mars Hopper is a short sci-fi platformer for Playdate where you bounce across the Red Planet, collect coins, and talk to strange locals.

You’re a tourist. The only way forward is up... and sideways... and maybe into a black hole.

https://owerapps.itch.io/mars-hopper
